skill_name: Generate an article discussing the pros and cons of eating organic food.
workflow:
Organic food is becoming increasingly popular in today's society, as people strive for healthy diets and more sustainable lifestyles. But what exactly is organic food, and is it worth the hype? This article discusses the pros and cons of eating organic food. 

One of the biggest advantages of eating organic food is that it is free of potentially harmful chemical fertilizers and pesticides. These substances can contaminate soil and water sources and can have a detrimental effect on human health.
